# Nagdev Products Private Limited — Product & Technical Reference

> Operational Castor Oil & Derivatives Manufacturing Plant · North Gujarat (Vav-Tharad District)

Summary: 7 grades in regular supply · 7 available on enquiry · 13 under development.

## Technical Specifications & Documentation
- Documentation available for buyer qualification: Certificate of Analysis (COA) per production lot, TDS (Technical Data Sheets), SDS (Safety Data Sheets).
- Third-party pre-shipment inspection (SGS, Bureau Veritas, Intertek) arranged at buyer's request and cost.
- Sales Terms: Spot volume orders and term supply contracts.

## Core Commercial & Technical Hubs
- Castor Oil Derivatives Hub: https://www.nagdevproducts.com/castor-oil-derivatives
  Full technical breakdown of 27 castor grades, ricinoleic acid chemistry, gelling mechanisms, and industrial polyols.
- Gujarat Manufacturing & Crushing Plant: https://www.nagdevproducts.com/castor-oil-manufacturer-gujarat
  Operational 50 TPD crushing plant in Sardarpura, Vav-Tharad district (North Gujarat), regional castor seed sourcing advantage, APMC network, and plant logistics.
- Bulk Castor Oil Supply & Packaging: https://www.nagdevproducts.com/bulk-castor-oil-supply
  Commercial procurement guide, ISO tanks, flexitanks, IBC totes, 200 kg steel drums, and 25 kg bags.
- Global Castor Oil Exporter from India: https://www.nagdevproducts.com/castor-oil-exporter-india
  International export operations, Kandla and Mundra port logistics, HS codes, Incoterms, and trade documentation.
